title: Training and match sensitivity separation
summary: Sensitivity can be changed deliberately during practice to target weaknesses, but match play should usually keep it stable so attention stays on the game instead of the setup.
cues: Use sensitivity changes with a clear training goal
Keep competitive matches focused on decision-making and execution, not setup doubt
Separate deliberate practice experiments from emotional mid-match changes
failureModes: Tilt-changing sensitivity after deaths or bad rounds
Confusing a training tool with a match-time fix
